Definition: Whether consumer protection legislation or regulations specifically address digital payment services, covering disclosure requirements, liability allocation for unauthorized transactions, error resolution procedures, and user rights.
Comments: Mauritania adopted a law related to electronic payment services in June 2021, intended to create an enabling regulatory environment and expand access to low-value transactional payment services ([UNCDF Policy Accelerator](https://policyaccelerator.uncdf.org/whats-new/mauritania-regulatory-framework)). The same source implies consumer protection remains a work-in-progress, so this is scored as partial rather than a comprehensive payments consumer protection regime.
